response.overview: The Mecosta Project: A psychological horror/slasher film Produced by Mullet FIlm Productions Directed By: Parker McFadden Our story follows The Protagonist Elliott Played by: Andrew Jaycox , A teen faced with an adverse homelife and a “Expiring Time” complex, however still remains to be a beacon of hope for the others, The main location is an ominous property in the middle of nowhere (great place to have a party on a friday night.)  Where 10 teens are lured and manipulated into coming to the property. Unbeknownst to them 30 years ago something malicious had taken place in this Malevolent manor. When things go awry for this entourage of misfits they try to leave but feel something lurking. They now try to piece together the puzzle of what's really going on at the Mecosta Manor.
response.title: The Mecosta Project
